WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::int AS quicklink_id,
    $2::sales_prod.marca_lead AS marca,
    $3::text AS nombre_cliente,
    $4::text AS ci_ruc,
    $5::text AS telefono_1,
    $6::text AS telefono_2,
    $7::text AS telefono_agente,
    $8::text AS correo_cliente,
    $9::text AS ciudad,
    $10::text AS chasis,
    $11::text AS modelo,
    $12::text AS clave_modelo,
    $13::text AS agencia,
    $14::text AS nombre_vendedor_ql,
    $15::text AS correo_vendedor_ql,
    NULLIF($16, '')::timestamptz AS fecha_venta,
    NULLIF($17, '')::timestamptz AS fecha_asignacion,
    NULLIF($18, '')::timestamptz AS fecha_gestion,
    NULLIF($19, '')::timestamptz AS fecha_final_gestion,
    $20::text AS estado_ql,
    $21::text AS observacion_ql,
    COALESCE($22::boolean, false) AS skip_upsert,
    NULLIF($23::text, '')::integer AS row_number
), candidate AS (
  SELECT
    i.*,
    self.id AS existing_id,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(COALESCE(i.ci_ruc, self.ci_ruc), ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS duplicate_ci_key,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(i.telefono_agente, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') AS duplicate_agent_phone_key
  FROM input i
  LEFT JOIN sales_prod.leads_quicklink AS self
    ON self.quicklink_id = i.quicklink_id
   AND self.marca = i.marca
), duplicate_existing AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.quicklink_id, c.marca)
    c.quicklink_id,
    c.marca,
    l.quicklink_id AS duplicate_quicklink_id,
    l.marca::text AS duplicate_marca
  FROM candidate c
  JOIN sales_prod.leads_quicklink AS l
    ON NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(l.ci_ruc, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') = c.duplicate_ci_key
   AND NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(l.telefono_agente, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), '') = c.duplicate_agent_phone_key
  WHERE NOT c.skip_upsert
    AND c.duplicate_ci_key IS NOT NULL
    AND c.duplicate_agent_phone_key IS NOT NULL
    AND (c.existing_id IS NULL OR l.id <> c.existing_id)
  ORDER BY c.quicklink_id, c.marca, l.created_at ASC NULLS LAST, l.updated_at ASC NULLS LAST
), eligible AS (
  SELECT c.*
  FROM candidate c
  WHERE NOT c.skip_upsert
    AND c.duplicate_agent_phone_key IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM duplicate_existing d
      WHERE d.quicklink_id = c.quicklink_id
        AND d.marca = c.marca
    )
), updated AS (
  UPDATE sales_prod.leads_quicklink AS l
  SET
    nombre_cliente = e.nombre_cliente,
    ci_ruc = COALESCE(e.ci_ruc, l.ci_ruc),
    telefono_1 = e.telefono_1,
    telefono_2 = COALESCE(e.telefono_2, l.telefono_2),
    telefono_agente = e.telefono_agente,
    correo_cliente = COALESCE(e.correo_cliente, l.correo_cliente),
    ciudad = COALESCE(e.ciudad, l.ciudad),
    chasis = COALESCE(e.chasis, l.chasis),
    modelo = COALESCE(e.modelo, l.modelo),
    clave_modelo = COALESCE(e.clave_modelo, l.clave_modelo),
    agencia = COALESCE(e.agencia, l.agencia),
    nombre_vendedor_ql = COALESCE(e.nombre_vendedor_ql, l.nombre_vendedor_ql),
    correo_vendedor_ql = COALESCE(e.correo_vendedor_ql, l.correo_vendedor_ql),
    fecha_venta = COALESCE(e.fecha_venta, l.fecha_venta),
    fecha_asignacion = COALESCE(e.fecha_asignacion, l.fecha_asignacion),
    fecha_gestion = COALESCE(e.fecha_gestion, l.fecha_gestion),
    fecha_final_gestion = COALESCE(e.fecha_final_gestion, l.fecha_final_gestion),
    estado_ql = COALESCE(e.estado_ql, l.estado_ql),
    observacion_ql = e.observacion_ql,
    ultima_sync_at = NOW(),
    veces_sincronizado = l.veces_sincronizado + 1,
    updated_at = NOW()
  FROM eligible e
  WHERE l.id = e.existing_id
  RETURNING l.quicklink_id, l.marca, false AS inserted, true AS affected
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO sales_prod.leads_quicklink (
    quicklink_id, marca, nombre_cliente, ci_ruc, telefono_1, telefono_2, telefono_agente,
    correo_cliente, ciudad, chasis, modelo, clave_modelo, agencia,
    nombre_vendedor_ql, correo_vendedor_ql, fecha_venta, fecha_asignacion,
    fecha_gestion, fecha_final_gestion, estado_ql, observacion_ql, ultima_sync_at
  )
  SELECT
    quicklink_id, marca, nombre_cliente, ci_ruc, telefono_1, telefono_2, telefono_agente,
    correo_cliente, ciudad, chasis, modelo, clave_modelo, agencia,
    nombre_vendedor_ql, correo_vendedor_ql, fecha_venta, fecha_asignacion,
    fecha_gestion, fecha_final_gestion, estado_ql, observacion_ql, NOW()
  FROM eligible
  WHERE existing_id IS NULL
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING quicklink_id, marca, true AS inserted, true AS affected
), affected AS (
  SELECT quicklink_id, marca, inserted, affected FROM updated
  UNION ALL
  SELECT quicklink_id, marca, inserted, affected FROM inserted
)
SELECT
  c.quicklink_id,
  c.marca::text AS marca,
  (
    c.skip_upsert
    OR c.duplicate_agent_phone_key IS NULL
    OR d.quicklink_id IS NOT NULL
    OR (NOT c.skip_upsert AND a.quicklink_id IS NULL)
  ) AS skip_upsert,
  COALESCE(a.inserted, false) AS inserted,
  COALESCE(a.affected, false) AS affected,
  CASE
    WHEN c.skip_upsert THEN '[]'::jsonb
    WHEN c.duplicate_agent_phone_key IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'row_number', c.row_number,
      'quicklink_id', c.quicklink_id,
      'field', 'telefono_agente',
      'reason', 'missing_agent_phone',
      'value_length', NULL,
      'value_limit', NULL,
      'value_preview', NULL
    ))
    WHEN d.quicklink_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'row_number', c.row_number,
      'quicklink_id', c.quicklink_id,
      'field', 'ci_ruc_telefono_agente',
      'reason', 'duplicate_cedula_agent_phone',
      'value_length', length(COALESCE(c.duplicate_ci_key, '')) + length(COALESCE(c.duplicate_agent_phone_key, '')),
      'value_limit', NULL,
      'value_preview', concat('[redacted:', length(COALESCE(c.duplicate_ci_key, '')), '+', length(COALESCE(c.duplicate_agent_phone_key, '')), ']'),
      'duplicate_quicklink_id', d.duplicate_quicklink_id,
      'duplicate_marca', d.duplicate_marca
    ))
    WHEN a.quicklink_id IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'row_number', c.row_number,
      'quicklink_id', c.quicklink_id,
      'field', 'ci_ruc_telefono_agente',
      'reason', 'duplicate_cedula_agent_phone_conflict',
      'value_length', length(COALESCE(c.duplicate_ci_key, '')) + length(COALESCE(c.duplicate_agent_phone_key, '')),
      'value_limit', NULL,
      'value_preview', concat('[redacted:', length(COALESCE(c.duplicate_ci_key, '')), '+', length(COALESCE(c.duplicate_agent_phone_key, '')), ']')
    ))
    ELSE '[]'::jsonb
  END AS _sync_errors
FROM candidate c
LEFT JOIN affected a
  ON a.quicklink_id = c.quicklink_id
 AND a.marca = c.marca
LEFT JOIN duplicate_existing d
  ON d.quicklink_id = c.quicklink_id
 AND d.marca = c.marca;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN $1::text ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN LEAST(GREATEST(($1::text)::integer, 1), 200)
    ELSE 30
  END AS limit_rows
), rows AS (
  SELECT s.*
  FROM sales_prod.sync_runs s, params p
  ORDER BY s.run_at DESC
  LIMIT (SELECT limit_rows FROM params)
)
SELECT
  'ok'::text AS status,
  'sales_prod.sync_runs'::text AS source,
  params.limit_rows AS limit,
  count(rows.id)::integer AS total,
  now() AS fetched_at,
  coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rows) ORDER BY rows.run_at DESC) FILTER (WHERE rows.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS data
FROM params
LEFT JOIN rows ON true
GROUP BY params.limit_rows;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS source,
    $2::text AS status,
    $3::integer AS kia_fetched,
    $4::integer AS kia_valid,
    $5::integer AS kia_invalid,
    $6::integer AS kia_upserted,
    $7::integer AS hyundai_fetched,
    $8::integer AS hyundai_valid,
    $9::integer AS hyundai_invalid,
    $10::integer AS hyundai_upserted,
    NULLIF($11::text, '') AS error
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO sales_prod.sync_runs (
    source, status,
    kia_fetched, kia_valid, kia_invalid, kia_upserted,
    hyundai_fetched, hyundai_valid, hyundai_invalid, hyundai_upserted,
    error
  )
  SELECT
    source, status,
    kia_fetched, kia_valid, kia_invalid, kia_upserted,
    hyundai_fetched, hyundai_valid, hyundai_invalid, hyundai_upserted,
    error
  FROM input
  RETURNING id, run_at
)
SELECT
  input.status,
  'refresh_existing'::text AS mode,
  input.source,
  (SELECT run_at FROM inserted) AS timestamp,
  (SELECT id FROM inserted) AS sync_run_id,
  input.kia_fetched,
  input.kia_valid,
  input.kia_invalid,
  input.kia_upserted AS kia_inserted,
  GREATEST(input.kia_valid - input.kia_upserted, 0) AS kia_existing_skipped,
  input.kia_upserted,
  input.hyundai_fetched,
  input.hyundai_valid,
  input.hyundai_invalid,
  input.hyundai_upserted AS hyundai_inserted,
  GREATEST(input.hyundai_valid - input.hyundai_upserted, 0) AS hyundai_existing_skipped,
  input.hyundai_upserted,
  input.error
FROM input;

INSERT INTO sales_prod.sync_lead_errors (
  sync_run_id, run_at, source, marca, quicklink_id, row_number,
  field, reason, value_length, value_limit, value_preview
)
SELECT
  $1::bigint,
  COALESCE(NULLIF($2::text, '')::timestamptz, now()),
  COALESCE(NULLIF($3::text, ''), 'scheduled'),
  $4::sales_prod.marca_lead,
  NULLIF($5::text, '')::integer,
  NULLIF($6::text, '')::integer,
  $7::text,
  $8::text,
  NULLIF($9::text, '')::integer,
  NULLIF($10::text, '')::integer,
  NULLIF($11::text, '')
RETURNING id, sync_run_id;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN $1::text ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN LEAST(GREATEST(($1::text)::integer, 1), 500)
      ELSE 100
    END AS limit_rows,
    CASE
      WHEN $2::text ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN ($2::text)::bigint
      ELSE NULL
    END AS sync_run_id,
    CASE
      WHEN upper($3::text) IN ('KIA', 'HYUNDAI') THEN upper($3::text)::sales_prod.marca_lead
      ELSE NULL
    END AS marca
), rows AS (
  SELECT e.*
  FROM sales_prod.sync_lead_errors e, params p
  WHERE (p.sync_run_id IS NULL OR e.sync_run_id = p.sync_run_id)
    AND (p.marca IS NULL OR e.marca = p.marca)
  ORDER BY e.run_at DESC, e.id DESC
  LIMIT (SELECT limit_rows FROM params)
)
SELECT
  'ok'::text AS status,
  'sales_prod.sync_lead_errors'::text AS source,
  params.limit_rows AS limit,
  params.sync_run_id,
  params.marca::text AS marca,
  count(rows.id)::integer AS total,
  now() AS fetched_at,
  coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rows) ORDER BY rows.run_at DESC, rows.id DESC) FILTER (WHERE rows.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS data
FROM params
LEFT JOIN rows ON true
GROUP BY params.limit_rows, params.sync_run_id, params.marca;
